verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own docs say it offers a network of 53 real street addresses across 44 states, including Park Avenue and Market Street. They also say the address can be listed on public records instead of a personal address, which points to business-registration use such as an LLC filing. Missing for 10: explicit evidence the address passes bank KYC checks, any mention of vendor or compliance form use, and independent or hands-on corroboration that institutions accept it as a non-PO-Box address.
